An '''annual lylek hunt''' was a regular event on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. During one year, a unique item was implanted in the stomach of one of the beasts as a special prize.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Treasure Hunting|Bug Guts}}</ref>
